urdu.name: عین النور
urdu.long_meaning: Ainur (عین النور) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم عین النور، آنکھ کی روشنی ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: عین‌النور
persian.long_meaning: Ainur (عین‌النور) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن عین‌النور، نور چشم است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

arabic.long_meaning: Ainur (عَيْنُ النُّور) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي عَيْنُ النُّور، نُورُ الْعَيْن. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

name_story.story: Ainur can be understood through the Arabic form عَيْنُ النُّور, whose central sense is ainur; light of the eye (compound). Ainur is a compound of Arabic عَيْن (ʿayn, 'eye') and نُور (nūr, 'light'), used as a female given name in Central Asia.

faq.a: Ainur is associated with the Arabic form عَيْنُ النُّور, whose core sense is ainur; light of the eye (compound).

faq.q: What is the origin of Ainur?
faq.a: Ainur is associated with Arabic. Ainur is a compound of Arabic عَيْن (ʿayn, 'eye') and نُور (nūr, 'light'), used as a female given name in Central Asia.
Yes — the underlying form عَيْنُ النُّور is Arabic.
Ainur can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Ainur should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ainur is a compound name, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.q: What does Ainur mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Ainur is rendered عین النور and carries the sense عین النور، آنکھ کی روشنی.

faq.q: What does Ainur mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Ainur is rendered عین‌النور and carries the sense عین‌النور، نور چشم.
A romanized syllable approximation is ai-nur. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Ainur?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Ainur, ainur. Script forms are عين النور, عَيْنُ النُّور, عین النور, عین‌النور, ऐनूर.

faq.q: Is Ainur a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
